speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent; I will be examining you. To understand why you are having seizures and feeling lethargic three days after birth, tell me: is your mother a diabetic?

speaker: Patient
text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. The antenatal period was complicated by chorioamnionitis. Apgar scores were 3 and 6 at 1 and 5 minutes, respectively. The patient has become increasingly lethargic over the past 18 hours and experienced a tonic seizure lasting for 25 seconds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypoglycemia secondary to intrauterine growth restriction and chorioamnionitis.

The patient is a 31-week SGA infant with a history of chorioamnionitis and poor Apgar scores, presenting with lethargy and seizures. Please provide the results of the bedside glucose check immediately.
